tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of castable refractory
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office YTPS Raichur

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender document for all the terms and conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have supplied castable refractory for Rs.3.16 Lakhs and above to any thermal power plants/process industries/cement companies etc, and shall furnish single/multiple Purchase Order copy/s as a proof issued by Chief Engineer/Project head/Competent authority
The bidder shall be a manufacturer/authorized dealer/Regular supplier for castable refractory as a proof relevant documents shall be furnished.

The bidder shall have achieved in his name/firm an average annual turnover of Rs.6.33 Lakhs in at least two financial years in previous five years i.e., 2025-26,2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 & 2021-22. As a proof of this the bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss statement duly certified by a chartered accountant

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Duly filled specification schedule mentioning make, model, delivery period, GST, HSN code clearly
